Consensus expectation is that copper prices will continue to rise against this fundamentally tight backdrop. however, there is no consensus about how quickly they will climb and to what level. The earliest that new mine projects will begin to significantly boost supply will be 2012. Wide ranging estimates of the degree of irreversible substitution by consumers in the short term is increasing the uncertainty over the size of the market surplus in the medium term. developments in China will be the key determining factor. in order to provide industry stakeholders with a regularly-updated and in-depth understanding of the market, Cru utilises our team of more than 20 full-time copper experts in our global offices to produce our Copper Quarterly industry and market Outlook.
